name: Teen Service Series and Park Pitch In
what_you_do: Remove invasive plants, maintain woodland trails and help restore the forest in Prospect Park. All tools are provided and you need no experience. You earn service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17 for the Teen Service Series. The Park Pitch In weekends are open to teens 14 and up, adults and groups. No experience needed.
pay_detail: Unpaid and free. You earn community service hours.
duration: Single days. Teen Service Series runs select Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays, June to October (times vary). Park Pitch In runs select weekends April to November.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each event. The page lists Teen Service Series days through October and Park Pitch In weekends through November. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online for each event through the Alliance volunteer page. Registration is required. Questions: (718) 965-8951. The phone number is listed under Contact Us.
notes: Unpaid volunteering, so no work permit. Some events have age limits, so check the age on each event. The Junior Volunteer Corps is for youth groups with children ages 4 to 13.
